data.name: Deni
data.gender_notes: Deni is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Deni means 'follower' or 'devotee'. This name was borne by a number of early Christian martyrs and saints, reflecting the deep faith and commitment to God's teachings. The name Deni carries the meaning “Follower, Devotee” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Deni usually hope their child will grow to embody follower, devotee and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Deni belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Follower, Devotee.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Deni total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: דני
in_hebrew.meaning: שם פרטי שפירושו שפט או דין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם דני הוא שם פרטי עברי שפירושו שפט או דין. הוא מופיע בתנ"ך כדמותו של דני, אחד מ-12 בניו של יעקב, וגם כנביא ומנהיג דני. השם נגזר מהמילה העברית 'דין' שפירושו שפט או משפט.

in_greek.name: Δανι
in_greek.meaning: όνομα που σημαίνει κριτής ή δικαστής
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Δανι είναι ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος דני (Dani), που σημαίνει κριτής ή δικαστής. Στο Χρηστικό πλαίσιο, το όνομα σχετίζεται με τον προφήτη Δανιήλ και τον Δανι, ένα από τα 12 παιδιά του Ιακώβ.

in_latin.name: Deni
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Deni is derived from the Hebrew name דני (Dani), meaning judge or lawgiver. In Christian tradition, the name is associated with the prophet Daniel and Deni, one of the 12 sons of Jacob. The name signifies spiritual leadership and divine judgment.

in_english.name: Deni
in_english.meaning: short for Daniel, meaning God is my judge
in_english.long_meaning: The name Deni is a shortened form of Daniel, originating from the Hebrew name דניאל (Daniel), meaning 'God is my judge.' It is associated with the prophet Daniel in the Bible, known for his wisdom and faith. The name signifies a strong spiritual connection and reliance on divine guidance.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Mary' is of Hebrew origin and has remained a popular name among Christians for centuries. In the Catholic Church, Mary is considered the Mother of God and plays a significant role in the Christian faith.
data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Mary' is a reminder of the belief in the divine motherhood of Mary and her role as an intercessor and protector.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Deni: God's lover, dedicated to divine knowledge and wisdom. In Danish, "Deni" means 'thinking' or 'contemplating', reflecting the spiritual journey of seeking truth through prayer and study.

biblical_reference.note: The name Deni is related to Dan, one of the 12 sons of Jacob.

historical_references.reference: Dennis the Menace, a popular comic strip and television series, was created in 1951 by Hank Ketcham.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Deni can be associated with denim due to the similarity in spelling and the popularity of the fabric in modern times. It can also be used as a form of denigration, particularly in online contexts.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Ruth Deni in London, United Kingdom credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Deni, which means "Follower, Devotee". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
